outcome: fetal complications (hydrops fetalis, fetal anemia, neonatal anemia, hyperbilirubinemia, neonatal jaundice)
perinatal outcome (gestational age at delivery, birth weight, low birth weight, preterm delivery, postdated pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 100 Rh-negative mothers with incompatible mating who delivered between March 2017 and February 2018.
finding: The study found a significant incidence of complications in Rh-negative pregnancies, including 28% low birth weight, 32% preterm delivery, 6% IUD, 7% NICU admission, and 10% neonatal jaundice.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.9 kg, with 28% classified as low birth weight.
